definitions.explanation: The age at which a person is considered old enough for romance or marriage, or the age of puberty and adolescence when one becomes self-conscious.
Used to indicate an approximate age or the age at which something typically happens.

examples.japanese: {年頃|としごろ}の{娘|むすめ}がいる。
examples.english: I have a daughter of marriageable age.

examples.japanese: {年頃|としごろ}になると{外見|がいけん}を{気|き}にし{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: When you reach that age, you start caring about your appearance.

examples.japanese: {年頃|としごろ}の{子|こ}どもは{親|おや}と{話|はな}したがらないものだ。
examples.english: Adolescents tend not to want to talk to their parents.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じ{年頃|としごろ}の{子|こ}と{遊|あそ}ばせたい。
examples.english: I want to let them play with children around the same age.

examples.japanese: あの{方|かた}は{五十|ごじゅう}{歳|さい}{年頃|としごろ}に{見|み}える。
examples.english: That person looks to be around fifty years old.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}に{上|あ}がる{年頃|としごろ}の{子|こ}が{多|おお}い{地域|ちいき}だ。
examples.english: It's an area with many children of school-starting age.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the most common usage, often referring to teenage or young adult years when someone becomes interested in romance. When parents say their child is {年頃|としごろ}, it often implies the child is entering puberty or becoming self-conscious. Sense 2 is more neutral, simply indicating an approximate age.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年頃|としごろ}の{娘|むすめ} (daughter of marriageable age)
- {同|おな}じ{年頃|としごろ} (around the same age)
- {年頃|としごろ}の{子|こ}ども (adolescent child)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年齢|ねんれい}: age — neutral, factual term
- {適齢期|てきれいき}: appropriate age (especially for marriage) — more direct
